$SPCX & $TSLA will never merge.  Love Cathie Woods, but a merger like this makes absolutely no sense whatsoever from a business standpoint.  First, either company could be the buyer, and the buyers stock price would be absolutely crushed by the dilution.  And then having one super big ass company like this would be loaded with unmanageable redundancies that would kill earnings and take years to hammer out.  Then, there is the US Justice Department who would never allow such a massive company, one so big that its actual existence could dictate the overall US economy.  They won't allow this to happen.  The only true solution, is for both companies to remain independent, focusing on their specialties under their current stock symbols, and forming a partnership with one another that is aimed at identical goals.  In this scenario, both stock prices skyrocket, as it truly is a case where the pieces are worth way more than the combined total.
